summary: Guided Meditation ambient sound selection and playback were updated to use the option’s value as a direct audio source (supporting both local asset paths and full https:// URLs), with error handling via English toast messages and playback switching when the selection changes. Two additional non-product files were also updated with broader, unrelated project summaries.

hallucinated_features.description: Updated broad app-level feature summaries unrelated to guided-meditation internet audio streaming (e.g., authentication, dashboard redesign, many pages/components).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked for REQ-41/REQ-42 changes to Guided Meditation ambient sound streaming logic; these summary/documentation updates are not requested deliverables.
